info.title: Temporal project API
info.description: Turns tasks described in conversation into requirements, API designs and verified code published to GitHub.

schemas.name: Credentials
schemas.description: A login and a password.

properties.name: login
properties.description: An email address or a username, case-insensitive.

schemas.name: Session
schemas.description: A signed-in session.

properties.name: access_token
properties.description: Bearer token, also set as the access_token cookie.

properties.name: admin
properties.description: Whether the user is the first user.

schemas.name: Profile
schemas.description: The signed-in user.

schemas.name: RegistrationStatus
schemas.description: Whether the first account can still be registered.

schemas.name: Account
schemas.description: A user account.

schemas.name: GitHubAppCredentials
schemas.description: A GitHub App to connect.

properties.name: private_key
properties.description: The app's private key in PEM format.

properties.name: account
properties.description: The account the app is installed on, when it is installed on several.

schemas.name: ManifestCode
schemas.description: The code GitHub returned after creating an app from a manifest.

schemas.name: EmptyObject
schemas.description: An empty JSON object.

schemas.name: GitHubApp
schemas.description: A GitHub App.

schemas.name: GitHubInstallation
schemas.description: Where the GitHub App is installed.

schemas.name: GitHubConnection
schemas.description: The shared GitHub connection; never its private key.

properties.name: app
properties.description: Null when not configured.

properties.name: installation
properties.description: Null until the app is installed.

schemas.name: Repository
schemas.description: A repository the GitHub App can access.

schemas.name: RepositoryPage
schemas.description: A page of repositories.

properties.name: next_page
properties.description: Null on the last page.

schemas.name: BranchPage
schemas.description: A page of branch names.

properties.name: next_page
properties.description: Null on the last page.

schemas.name: RepositoryInput
schemas.description: A repository and branch to work in.

properties.name: full_name
properties.description: owner/name

schemas.name: RepositorySelection
schemas.description: The repository a session works in.

schemas.name: Question
schemas.description: A question asked of the user, with options to choose from.

schemas.name: Message
schemas.description: A message of a conversation.

properties.name: questions
properties.description: Asked by an assistant message; the next user message answers them.

schemas.name: TaskKindOption
schemas.description: A kind of task.

schemas.name: Intake
schemas.description: The questions every requirements session starts with.

properties.name: questions
properties.description: The questions of each kind, by kind, as Question lists.

schemas.name: CreateRequirementsSession
schemas.description: The intake of a new requirements session.

properties.name: answers
properties.description: One answer per question of the kind, in order.

properties.name: task
properties.description: What needs to be done; at most 10000 characters.

schemas.name: SessionCreated
schemas.description: A session that was started.

schemas.name: MessageInput
schemas.description: A user message.

properties.name: message
properties.description: 1 to 10000 characters after trimming.

schemas.name: AnswersInput
schemas.description: Answers to the questions of the last assistant message.

properties.name: answers
properties.description: One per question, in order.

schemas.name: AgentAnswersInput
schemas.description: Answers to the questions of a paused delivery agent.

properties.name: workflow_id
properties.description: The stage workflow of the agent that asked.

schemas.name: RetryStageInput
schemas.description: The delivery stage to retry.

schemas.name: ForkInput
schemas.description: Where a fork starts.

properties.name: message_index
properties.description: The last message the fork keeps.

schemas.name: SessionStatusChange
schemas.description: A session after an accepted request.

schemas.name: Requirement
schemas.description: A requirement of the task.

schemas.name: RequirementsSession
schemas.description: A requirements session and its delivery.

properties.name: retired
properties.description: Requirements of the repository's contract the change ends.

properties.name: document
properties.description: The requirements document, once written.

properties.name: delivery
properties.description: Progress of the delivery of a bugfix or documentation task.

schemas.name: StartApiDesignSession
schemas.description: The requirements session an API design continues.

schemas.name: ApiDesignSession
schemas.description: An API design session and its delivery.

properties.name: api
properties.description: The designed endpoints and schemas.

properties.name: language
properties.description: The implementation language, once chosen.

properties.name: document
properties.description: The OpenAPI document, once rendered.

properties.name: problems
properties.description: What must be settled before the design can be finalized.

properties.name: publication
properties.description: The branch the delivery pushed.

properties.name: agent_questions
properties.description: Questions of paused delivery agents. The other delivery progress fields (code, implementation, tests, repairs and their errors) are returned alongside.

schemas.name: LLMRequestInput
schemas.description: A chat request. Also accepted as multipart form data with one file.

schemas.name: LLMRequestStarted
schemas.description: A chat request that is running.

schemas.name: LLMRequest
schemas.description: A chat request and its conversation.

schemas.name: WorkflowExecution
schemas.description: A workflow execution.

schemas.name: WorkflowPage
schemas.description: A page of workflow executions.

schemas.name: WorkflowResult
schemas.description: The result of the sample workflow.
